text: {"bodies":["From our leak meeting, Riikka Laitinen (e35) remains the clear starting point since she stood out on the Project Saimaa roadmap list and kept reopening restricted sections.","Checking the doc logs on Riikka Laitinen (e35) backs up yesterday's meeting point, as she was once again the last person accessing the Project Saimaa roadmap.","Typical move in today's Sales meeting by Tuomas Rantanen (e22), brushing aside my doc review on the Project Saimaa roadmap while hoarding his own private copies."]}
